tickets.editorial_job: Ground the after-hours event in a recognizably local service reality without inventing a company or customer
semantic_requirements: anonymous homeowner initiating a call after dark
unanswered service phone or neutral after-hours call context
ordinary local-trade environment rather than luxury or corporate office
rights_and_release_requirements: appearance release for every identifiable person
tickets.source_preference: Owner-commissioned local shoot with controlled anonymous framing
tickets.crop_and_focal_needs: Landscape master with homeowner/phone focal action inside x=0.12–0.76 and clean negative space at frame right for the work-order card
tickets.synthetic_reconstruction_policy: No AI image/video. A clearly labeled neutral geometric slate is the only rehearsal substitute.
acceptance_tests: reads as after-hours within one second
supports tag extraction without covering the hand/phone contact
tickets.placeholder_behavior: Large paper slate labeled AST-REALITY-001 / REALITY PLATE MISSING / SYNTHETIC REHEARSAL

tickets.editorial_job: Show the real source context for missed-call time, classification, review, and outcome fields while protecting customer data
semantic_requirements: real operator-side call or dispatch record
visible source context before any highlight
canonical capture date and source URL/system recorded privately
exclusions: clean stat card replacing source context
tickets.source_preference: Direct redacted capture supplied by the participating operator

technical_requirements.text_legibility: source field readable after approved crop

tickets.crop_and_focal_needs: Full-context master plus a reproducible crop around one call-time row; warning/attribution area must remain visible
tickets.synthetic_reconstruction_policy: Reconstruction allowed only when explicitly labeled on every frame and never accepted as public evidence
acceptance_tests: source remains identifiable as source context
tickets.placeholder_behavior: The local fixture CSV is displayed with SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT EVIDENCE in the largest source header

tickets.editorial_job: Make human judgment visible as an operational action that blocks, reviews, and releases or suppresses an uncertain case
semantic_requirements: deliberate hand or body action before release
tickets.source_preference: Directed operator pickup shot with hands and physical review action

technical_requirements.frame_rate: match master or allow clean optical conform

tickets.crop_and_focal_needs: Hand/action must fit x=0.52–0.88, y=0.28–0.82 and leave the red tag identity visible
tickets.synthetic_reconstruction_policy: No generated human. Geometric hand/action slate only for rehearsal.
acceptance_tests: no implied diagnosis or emergency advice
tickets.placeholder_behavior: Opaque slate shaped as the intended hand/action zone, labeled AST-OPERATOR-003 / HUMAN REVIEW PLATE

tickets.editorial_job: Confirm a scheduled service appointment tied to the original call without inventing money, conversion performance, or a customer-facing receipt
semantic_requirements: operator-side scheduled appointment or work order
traceable link to original call record
measurement fields available without a claimed result

technical_requirements.text_legibility: scheduled state readable without unsafe zoom

tickets.crop_and_focal_needs: Scheduled status and original-call relationship inside a stable 4:5 card crop placed at frame right
tickets.synthetic_reconstruction_policy: A clearly labeled work-order card with fictional ID WO-R01 is allowed only in this rehearsal and blocks public delivery
acceptance_tests: rehearsal card cannot be confused with evidence
tickets.placeholder_behavior: Paper card labeled AST-OUTCOME-004 / SYNTHETIC WORK ORDER / NOT EVIDENCE

tickets.editorial_job: Supply restrained after-hours room tone that makes the opening physical without pushing suspense
rights_and_release_requirements: original field recording or explicitly licensed production library
tickets.synthetic_reconstruction_policy: No synthetic ambience in this rehearsal; silence is preferred to an unapproved stand-in
acceptance_tests: contains no speech or identifying sound
supports clean loop or room-tone extension
tickets.placeholder_behavior: Silence; ticket listed in sound plan, not represented by attractive audio

tickets.editorial_job: Clarify six operation contacts: ring, paper receive, gate stop, gate release, suppression, schedule stamp
semantic_requirements: each cue maps to one business verb
rights_and_release_requirements: original recording or explicitly licensed library
tickets.source_preference: Original local Foley recorded from paper, wood, and a neutral telephone bell
tickets.synthetic_reconstruction_policy: No generated SFX. Current animatic remains VO-only unless these exact local cues are recorded.
acceptance_tests: every cue has a named operation
tickets.placeholder_behavior: No audio; timing intent exists only in scene direction and sound plan
